title_vi: Cụm từ và mệnh đề so sánh
theory_html:
A. as … as

We use as + adjective / adverb + as to say that something or someone is like something or someone else, or that one situation is like another:

Dùng as + tính từ / trạng từ + as để nói người/vật giống người/vật khác, hoặc tình huống này giống tình huống khác:

  • Was the film as funny as his last one?

    Bộ phim có hài như phim trước của anh ấy không?

  • I came round as quickly as I could.

    Tôi đến nhanh nhất có thể.

Negative forms of sentences like this can use either not as or not so. In formal speech and writing it is more common to use less + adjective + than:

Dạng phủ định có thể dùng not as hoặc not so. Trong văn nói và viết trang trọng, thường dùng less + tính từ + than:

  • The gap between the sides is not as / so wide as it was. (or … is less wide than it was.)

    Khoảng cách giữa hai bên không còn lớn như trước.

B. as + adjective + a / an + noun + as

B. as + tính từ + a / an + danh từ + as

If we put a singular countable noun between an adjective and the second as, we use a / an in front of the noun:

Nếu đặt danh từ đếm được số ít giữa tính từ và as thứ hai, ta dùng a / an trước danh từ:

  • Despite his disability, he tried to lead as normal a life as possible. (not … as normal life as …)

    Dù khuyết tật, anh ấy cố sống một cuộc sống bình thường nhất có thể.

The negative form of sentences like this can use either not as or sometimes not such:

Dạng phủ định có thể dùng not as hoặc đôi khi not such:

  • It’s not as quiet a place (or … not such a quiet place …) as it used to be.

    Nơi đây không còn yên tĩnh như trước.

Note that we use not as + adjective + a / an + noun but not such a / an + adjective + noun.

Lưu ý: not as + tính từ + a / an + danh từ, nhưng not such a / an + tính từ + danh từ.

We can use so, too and how followed by an adjective in a similar way:

Có thể dùng so, too và how + tính từ theo cách tương tự:

  • It’s not quite so straightforward a problem as it might at first seem.

    Đó không hẳn là vấn đề đơn giản như thoạt nhìn.

  • ‘Conspiracy’ is perhaps too strong a word.

    ‘Âm mưu’ có lẽ là từ quá nặng.

  • How big a piece do you want?

    Bạn muốn miếng to cỡ nào?

C. as much / many as; as little / few as

We also use as much / many as or as little / few as to say that a quantity or amount is larger or smaller than expected. Many and few are preferred before numbers; much and little are preferred with amounts (e.g. $5, 20%) and distances (e.g. 3 metres):

Dùng as much / many as hoặc as little / few as để nói số lượng lớn hoặc nhỏ hơn dự kiến. Many và few dùng trước số đếm; much và little dùng với lượng (vd. $5, 20%) và khoảng cách (vd. 3 mét):

  • There are a small number of people involved, possibly as few as twenty.

    Có ít người liên quan, có lẽ chỉ khoảng hai mươi.

  • Prices have increased by as much as 300%.

    Giá đã tăng tới 300%.

D. enough, sufficiently

We can use not + adjective / adverb + enough + to-infinitive to mean that there isn’t as much as is necessary to do something:

Dùng not + tính từ / trạng từ + enough + to-infinitive nghĩa là không đủ để làm gì:

  • I’m not tall enough to reach.

    Tôi không đủ cao để với tới.

  • He didn’t speak loudly enough to be heard.

    Anh ấy nói không đủ to để người khác nghe thấy.

We can use sufficiently before adjectives to express a similar meaning to enough. Sufficiently is often preferred in more formal contexts:

Có thể dùng sufficiently trước tính từ với nghĩa tương tự enough. Sufficiently thường dùng trong ngữ cảnh trang trọng hơn:

  • She didn’t play sufficiently well to qualify. (or … well enough to qualify.)

    Cô ấy chơi chưa đủ tốt để giành quyền vào vòng trong.

E. too

We can use too + adjective / adverb + to-infinitive to mean ‘more than necessary, possible, etc.’ to do something:

Dùng too + tính từ / trạng từ + to-infinitive nghĩa là ‘quá … để làm gì’:

  • They arrived too late to get seats.

    Họ đến quá muộn nên không có chỗ ngồi.

  • It moved too fast to see it clearly.

    Nó di chuyển quá nhanh nên không nhìn rõ được.

  • The suitcase was too small (for him) to get all his clothes in.

    Chiếc vali quá nhỏ để anh ấy nhét hết quần áo vào.

In rather formal English we can use too + adjective + a / an + noun:

Trong văn khá trang trọng, có thể dùng too + tính từ + a / an + danh từ:

  • I hope you haven’t had too tiring a day. (not … a too tiring day.)

    Mong là bạn không có một ngày quá mệt mỏi.

F. so … that; so … as to; go so far as to

We can use so + adjective / adverb + that-clause to say that something existed or happened to such a degree that a specified result occurred:

Dùng so + tính từ / trạng từ + mệnh đề that để nói điều gì đó ở mức độ đến nỗi dẫn đến kết quả:

  • It’s so simple that even I can do it.

    Nó đơn giản đến mức ngay cả tôi cũng làm được.

  • He came in so quietly that I didn’t hear him.

    Anh ấy vào nhẹ nhàng đến nỗi tôi không nghe thấy.

Less often we use so + adjective / adverb + as + to-infinitive with a similar meaning. Compare:

Ít gặp hơn, ta dùng so + tính từ / trạng từ + as + to-infinitive với nghĩa tương tự. So sánh:

  • The difference was so small that it wasn’t worth arguing about.

    Khác biệt nhỏ đến mức chẳng đáng tranh cãi.

  • The difference was so small as to not be worth arguing about.

    Khác biệt nhỏ đến mức chẳng đáng tranh cãi.

We can use go so / as far as + to-infinitive to talk about actions that are surprising or extreme:

Dùng go so / as far as + to-infinitive để nói về hành động gây ngạc nhiên hoặc cực đoan:

  • One furious woman went so / as far as to throw tomatoes at the minister.

    Một phụ nữ giận dữ thậm chí còn ném cà chua vào bộ trưởng.

mcq.question: Was the film ___ his last one?
mcq.full: Was the film as funny as his last one?
mcq.vi: Bộ phim có hài như phim trước của anh ấy không?
mcq.expl:
as + adj / adv + as; negative not as / not so … as, or formally less … than.
as + tính từ / trạng từ + as; phủ định not as / not so … as, hoặc trang trọng less … than.
Điểm ngữ pháp: as … as.
mcq.key: Was the film ___ his last one?|as funny as

mcq.question: I came round ___ I could.
mcq.full: I came round as quickly as I could.
mcq.vi: Tôi đến nhanh nhất có thể.
mcq.expl:
as + adj / adv + as; negative not as / not so … as, or formally less … than.
as + tính từ / trạng từ + as; phủ định not as / not so … as, hoặc trang trọng less … than.
Điểm ngữ pháp: as + trạng từ + as.
mcq.key: I came round ___ I could.|as quickly as

mcq.question: The gap between the sides is ___ it was.
mcq.full: The gap between the sides is less wide than it was.
mcq.vi: Khoảng cách giữa hai bên không còn lớn như trước.
mcq.expl:
as + adj / adv + as; negative not as / not so … as, or formally less … than.
as + tính từ / trạng từ + as; phủ định not as / not so … as, hoặc trang trọng less … than.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Trang trọng: less … than.
mcq.key: The gap between the sides is ___ it was.|less wide than

mcq.question: He’s obviously not so fit ___ he used to be.
mcq.full: He’s obviously not so fit as he used to be.
mcq.vi: Rõ ràng anh ấy không còn khỏe như trước.
mcq.expl:
as + adj / adv + as; negative not as / not so … as, or formally less … than.
as + tính từ / trạng từ + as; phủ định not as / not so … as, hoặc trang trọng less … than.
Điểm ngữ pháp: not so / as … as.
mcq.key: He’s obviously not so fit ___ he used to be.|as

mcq.question: Is it ___ has been claimed in the newspapers?
mcq.full: Is it as serious as has been claimed in the newspapers?
mcq.vi: Nó có nghiêm trọng như báo chí nói không?
mcq.expl:
as + adj / adv + as; negative not as / not so … as, or formally less … than.
as + tính từ / trạng từ + as; phủ định not as / not so … as, hoặc trang trọng less … than.
Điểm ngữ pháp: as … as.
mcq.key: Is it ___ has been claimed in the newspapers?|as serious as

mcq.question: Despite his disability, he tried to lead ___ possible.
mcq.full: Despite his disability, he tried to lead as normal a life as possible.
mcq.vi: Dù khuyết tật, anh ấy cố sống một cuộc sống bình thường nhất có thể.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: as + adj + a + noun + as.
mcq.key: Despite his disability, he tried to lead ___ possible.|as normal a life as

mcq.question: It’s not ___ as it used to be.
mcq.full: It’s not such a quiet place as it used to be.
mcq.vi: Nơi đây không còn là chốn yên tĩnh như trước.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: not such a + adj + noun.
mcq.key: It’s not ___ as it used to be.|such a quiet place

mcq.full: It’s not quite so straightforward a problem as it might at first seem.
mcq.vi: Đó không hẳn là vấn đề đơn giản như thoạt nhìn.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.

Điểm ngữ pháp: so + adj + a + noun.
mcq.key: It’s not quite so ___ as it might at first seem.|straightforward a problem

mcq.question: ‘Conspiracy’ is perhaps ___.
mcq.full: ‘Conspiracy’ is perhaps too strong a word.
mcq.vi: ‘Âm mưu’ có lẽ là từ quá nặng.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.

mcq.key: ‘Conspiracy’ is perhaps ___.|too strong a word

mcq.question: ___ do you want?
mcq.full: How big a piece do you want?
mcq.vi: Bạn muốn miếng to cỡ nào?
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: how + adj + a + noun.
mcq.key: ___ do you want?|How big a piece

mcq.question: The President’s address to the nation is ___ as he is ever likely to make in his career.
mcq.full: The President’s address to the nation is as important a speech as he is ever likely to make in his career.
mcq.vi: Bài phát biểu trước quốc dân của Tổng thống là bài quan trọng nhất ông có thể có trong sự nghiệp.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: as + adj + a + noun + as.
mcq.key: The President’s address to the nation is ___ as he is ever likely to make in his career.|as important a speech

mcq.question: Theresa’s dog is ___ as I’ve ever seen.
mcq.full: Theresa’s dog is as ferocious an animal as I’ve ever seen.
mcq.vi: Con chó của Theresa là con vật hung dữ nhất tôi từng thấy.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: as + adj + an + noun + as.
mcq.key: Theresa’s dog is ___ as I’ve ever seen.|as ferocious an animal

mcq.question: It wasn’t ___ as I first thought.
mcq.full: It wasn’t such a big problem as I first thought.
mcq.vi: Đó không phải vấn đề lớn như tôi tưởng ban đầu.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: not such a + adj + noun.
mcq.key: It wasn’t ___ as I first thought.|such a big problem

mcq.question: She’s not ___ as she claims to be.
mcq.full: She’s not as fluent a Greek speaker as she claims to be.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy không nói tiếng Hy Lạp trôi chảy như cô ấy nói.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: not as + adj + a + noun.
mcq.key: She’s not ___ as she claims to be.|as fluent a Greek speaker

mcq.question: ___ is it?
mcq.full: How serious an injury is it?
mcq.vi: Chấn thương nghiêm trọng đến mức nào?
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: how + adj + an + noun.
mcq.key: ___ is it?|How serious an injury

mcq.question: He’s not ___ as he was in his twenties.
mcq.full: He’s not such a good player as he was in his twenties.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy không còn là cầu thủ giỏi như hồi đôi mươi.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: not such a + adj + noun.
mcq.key: He’s not ___ as he was in his twenties.|such a good player

mcq.question: We all wish him ___ as possible.
mcq.full: We all wish him as speedy a recovery as possible.
mcq.vi: Tất cả chúng tôi chúc anh ấy sớm bình phục nhất có thể.
mcq.expl:
as / so / too / how + adjective + a / an + noun (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + adjective + noun.
as / so / too / how + tính từ + a / an + danh từ (as normal a life as, too strong a word); not such a + tính từ + danh từ.
Điểm ngữ pháp: as + adj + a + noun + as.
mcq.key: We all wish him ___ as possible.|as speedy a recovery

mcq.question: There are a small number of people involved, possibly as ___ as twenty.
mcq.full: There are a small number of people involved, possibly as few as twenty.
mcq.vi: Có ít người liên quan, có lẽ chỉ khoảng hai mươi.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: few + số đếm.
mcq.key: There are a small number of people involved, possibly as ___ as twenty.|few

mcq.question: Prices have increased by as ___ as 300%.
mcq.full: Prices have increased by as much as 300%.
mcq.vi: Giá đã tăng tới 300%.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: much + phần trăm.
mcq.key: Prices have increased by as ___ as 300%.|much

mcq.question: When it was really hot I was having as ___ as four showers a day.
mcq.full: When it was really hot I was having as many as four showers a day.
mcq.vi: Khi trời rất nóng, tôi tắm tới bốn lần một ngày.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: many + số đếm.
mcq.key: When it was really hot I was having as ___ as four showers a day.|many

mcq.question: The elephant population may soon fall to as ___ as 1,000 from 5,000 ten years ago.
mcq.full: The elephant population may soon fall to as few as 1,000 from 5,000 ten years ago.
mcq.vi: Số lượng voi có thể sớm giảm xuống chỉ còn 1.000 con từ 5.000 con mười năm trước.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: few + số đếm.
mcq.key: The elephant population may soon fall to as ___ as 1,000 from 5,000 ten years ago.|few

mcq.question: At the end of the 200-metre race there was as ___ as 50 metres between the first and second runners.
mcq.full: At the end of the 200-metre race there was as much as 50 metres between the first and second runners.
mcq.vi: Cuối cuộc đua 200 mét, khoảng cách giữa người thứ nhất và thứ hai lên tới 50 mét.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: much + khoảng cách.
mcq.key: At the end of the 200-metre race there was as ___ as 50 metres between the first and second runners.|much

mcq.question: As ___ as 5,000 people phoned in to complain about last night’s TV programme.
mcq.full: As many as 5,000 people phoned in to complain about last night’s TV programme.
mcq.vi: Có tới 5.000 người gọi điện phàn nàn về chương trình TV tối qua.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: many + số đếm.
mcq.key: As ___ as 5,000 people phoned in to complain about last night’s TV programme.|many

mcq.question: Lit continuously, the life of a light bulb varies from as ___ as two weeks to three months.
mcq.full: Lit continuously, the life of a light bulb varies from as little as two weeks to three months.
mcq.vi: Bật liên tục, tuổi thọ bóng đèn dao động từ chỉ hai tuần đến ba tháng.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: little + khoảng thời gian.
mcq.key: Lit continuously, the life of a light bulb varies from as ___ as two weeks to three months.|little

mcq.question: Some days there were as ___ as three or four students at his lectures.
mcq.full: Some days there were as few as three or four students at his lectures.
mcq.vi: Có hôm chỉ có ba bốn sinh viên dự giờ giảng của ông.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: few + số đếm.
mcq.key: Some days there were as ___ as three or four students at his lectures.|few

mcq.question: We don’t use much electricity. Sometimes our bill is as ___ as £40 a month.
mcq.full: We don’t use much electricity. Sometimes our bill is as little as £40 a month.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi dùng ít điện. Có tháng hóa đơn chỉ 40 bảng.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: little + số tiền.
mcq.key: We don’t use much electricity. Sometimes our bill is as ___ as £40 a month.|little

mcq.full: The country spends as much as 25% of its income on defence.
mcq.vi: Đất nước chi tới 25% thu nhập cho quốc phòng.
mcq.expl:
as many / few as + numbers; as much / little as + amounts and distances.
as many / few as + số đếm; as much / little as + lượng và khoảng cách.
Điểm ngữ pháp: much + phần trăm.
mcq.key: The country spends as ___ as 25% of its income on defence.|much

mcq.question: I’m not ___ to reach.
mcq.full: I’m not tall enough to reach.
